problem.title: Your inbox grows faster than your team
problem.text: Routine questions about orders, returns, and delivery times fill the queue. Customers wait, agents repeat the same answers, and the hard conversations get less attention than they deserve.

benefits.title: Less queue, better conversations
benefits.subtitle: Four things Relaydesk does for a support team every day.

items.title: Answers routine questions
items.text: Order status, returns, and delivery questions get a correct reply in seconds, drawn from your help center and order records.

items.title: Support analytics you can act on
items.text: See which questions repeat, where replies stall, and which topics need a better help article.

items.title: Works with your tools
items.text: Connects to the inbox, help desk, and store your team already uses, so nothing moves to a new system.

items.title: Replies that sound like your team
items.text: Drafts follow your tone and your policies, and an agent reviews anything the assistant is unsure about.

tagline: Every customer gets an answer. Your team gets the conversations that matter.

items.q: Does Relaydesk reply without a human checking?
items.a: Only for the topics you approve. Anything outside that list, or any reply the assistant is unsure about, goes to an agent first.

items.q: Which tools does it connect to?
items.a: Email inboxes, common help desks, and online stores. The full list of supported integrations is published on the integrations page.

items.q: How does it learn our tone?
items.a: It reads your past replies and your help center articles. You can also add tone rules, such as how formal replies should be.

items.q: What happens when it gets a question wrong?
items.a: An agent corrects the reply in one click. The correction is saved and used for similar questions in future.

items.q: Can we keep our data private?
items.a: Your conversations are used only to answer your customers. Data handling terms are in the privacy policy linked in the footer.

items.q: What if a customer asks for a human?
items.a: The conversation moves to an agent right away, with the full history attached, so the customer never repeats the question.
